title: Hybridisation of in silico and in vitro bioassays for studying the activation of Nrf2 by natural compounds.
authors: Nguyen, Bui Quoc Huy; Le, Nguyen Thien Han; Nguyen, Thi Yen Nhi; Nguyen, Hoang Khue Tu; Yen, Chia-Hung; Nguyen, Minh Hien
one_liner_zh: 该文结合机器学习与分子对接/动力学模拟筛选Nrf2激活剂，聚焦Keap1/Nrf2蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，方法可迁移但对象偏离核心体系。
abstract: Oxidative stress, characterized by the damaging accumulation of free radicals, is associated with various diseases, including cardiovascular, neurodegenerative, and metabolic disorders. The transcription factor Nrf2 is pivotal in cellular defense against oxidative stress by regulating genes that detoxify free radicals, thus maintaining redox homeostasis and preventing cellular aging. Keap1 plays a regulatory role through its interaction with Nrf2, ensuring Nrf2 degradation under homeostatic conditions and facilitating its stabilization and nuclear translocation during oxidative stress. In the initial stage of our study, we conducted in vitro assays on HaCaT cells, a human keratinocyte cell line, to measure the expression levels of Nrf2 to reveal the activity of promising medicinal plants, which were then selected for further evaluation. Subsequently, this study leverages in silico techniques, integrating machine learning with molecular docking and dynamics, to screen natural compounds that potentially activate Nrf2. Data from the ChEMBL database were categorized into active and inactive compounds and used for training different machine-learning models to predict potential Nrf2 activators. The best-performing model was used to select compounds for further evaluation via molecular docking and dynamics, assessing their interactions with Keap1/Nrf2. The LC-MS/MS-based chemical profiles also validated the presence of these chemical compounds. This approach underscores the synergy between in vitro bioassays and in silico approaches in identifying Nrf2 activators, offering a cost-effective strategy for drug development.
abstract_zh: 氧化应激，以自由基的有害积累为特征，与多种疾病相关，包括心血管疾病、神经退行性疾病和代谢紊乱。转录因子Nrf2在细胞防御氧化应激中起关键作用，通过调控解毒自由基的基因，从而维持氧化还原稳态并防止细胞衰老。Keap1通过与Nrf2的相互作用发挥调控作用，确保在稳态条件下Nrf2降解，并在氧化应激期间促进其稳定化和核转位。在我们研究的初始阶段，我们对HaCaT细胞（一种人角质形成细胞系）进行了体外实验，以测量Nrf2的表达水平，从而揭示有前景的药用植物的活性，随后选择这些植物进行进一步评估。接下来，本研究利用计算机模拟技术，将机器学习与分子对接和动力学相结合，筛选可能激活Nrf2的天然化合物。来自ChEMBL数据库的数据被分类为活性化合物和非活性化合物，并用于训练不同的机器学习模型，以预测潜在的Nrf2激活剂。表现最佳的模型被用于选择化合物，通过分子对接和动力学进一步评估其与Keap1/Nrf2的相互作用。基于LC-MS/MS的化学谱图也验证了这些化合物的存在。该方法强调了体外生物测定与计算机模拟方法在识别Nrf2激活剂中的协同作用，为药物开发提供了一种成本效益高的策略。
